CustomField.description: How the survey greets this guest, copied from their contact as the invitation is prepared. It is stored here because the public survey must never read a Contact record: without it the page would have to fall back to the booking's main contact, and the second traveller on a trip would be greeted by the first one's name.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The name the survey greets this guest with. Set automatically.
CustomField.label: Guest Name
